lines.text: Three marks around an unlisted door. I say the invoice does not mention it. File your inspection beside that claim; do not make either stand in for the other.
Seal intact. Reading warm. Those are the readings. Do not write a cause into the temperature column.
The header is earlier. The copy establishes that much. Directorate still has to answer for the name on its old routing entry.
My recovery list calls it Directorate property. Your unit is warm. Put the temperature on the card; leave the cause blank until we have one.
Hardline. Read the recovery card. Directorate needs someone who brings the record back.
Warm telemetry. Directorate wants the unit and the record of where you found it. Read the delivery terms.
Directorate has a recovery in the third ring. You are expendable enough to be useful.
Read the objective. Bring back the record. Directorate can afford opinions after that.
